root_cause.text: The L2CAP protocol handler for Enhanced Credit Based Mode connection requests did not verify that the command identifier was unique per signaling channel, allowing multiple requests with the same identifier to be queued as pending, which could cause an overflow in the allocation of channel resources exceeding `L2CAP_ECRED_MAX_CID`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "the code attempts to accept requests regardless of the command identifier which may cause multiple requests to be marked as pending... causing more than L2CAP_ECRED_MAX_CID(5) to be allocated... causing an overflow." The patch adds a check using `__l2cap_chan_list_id` to reject requests if there are already pending channels with the same identifier.
